Item.Name: EQUIPMENT_TYPE
Item.Hint: Enter the Equipment type, or use [LISTVAL].

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if (:ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type is not null) then
 begin
 select substr(mc.code_desc,1,20)
 into :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_desc
 from equip_master_codes mc
 where mc.code_type = 'EQUIP'
 and mc.code = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('1306');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 GO_ITEM ('equipment_id');
 else
 GO_ITEM ('ctrl_blk_1.qc_status');
 end if;
end;

Item.Name: EQUIPMENT_ID
Item.Hint: Enter the equipment ID, or use [LISTVAL].

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 execute_trigger ('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 if (:ctrl_blk_1.equipment_id is not null) then
 begin
 GO_ITEM ('equipment_reference');
 if (:ctrl_blk_1.equipment_reference is null) then
 begin
 select e.equip_reference
 into :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_reference
 from equipment e
 where e.equip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type
 and e.equip_id = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_id
 and e.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when too_many_rows then
 :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_reference := null;
 list_values;
 end;
 end if;
 end;
 else
 GO_ITEM ('ctrl_blk_1.qc_status');
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if(:ctrl_blk_1.equipment_id is not null) then
 begin
 select 'X' into :global.x from equipment e
 where e.equip_id = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_id
 and e.equip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type
 and e.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /* Modified by HCL Consulting */
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error ('1306');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then null;
 end;
 end if;
end;

begin

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if (:ctrl_blk_1.start_date is not null) then
 GO_ITEM ('end_date');
 else
 :SYSTEM.message_level :=5;
 go_block ('qc_data');
 execute_query;
 go_record ('1');
 :SYSTEM.message_level :=0;
 if (:qc_data.equip_reference is null) then
 go_block ('ctrl_blk_1');
 GO_ITEM ('equipment_type');
 show_error ('1370');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 exception when value_error then null;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 begin
 if (:ctrl_blk_1.end_date is not null) then
 if (:ctrl_blk_1.end_date < :ctrl_blk_1.start_date) then
 show_error ('8050');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 exception when value_error then null;
 end;
 :SYSTEM.message_level :=5;
 go_block ('qc_data');
 execute_query;
 go_record ('1');
 :SYSTEM.message_level :=0;
 if (:qc_data.equip_reference is null) then
 go_block ('ctrl_blk_1');
 GO_ITEM ('equipment_type');
 show_error ('1370');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;

Block.Name: QC_DATA
Block.WhereClause: where equip_qc_hdr.equip_reference in (select e.equip_reference from equipment e where nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type, e.equip_type) = e.equip_type and nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.equipment_id, e.equip_id) = e.equip_id and nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.equipment_reference, e.equip_reference) = e.equip_reference and :GLOBAL.chapter_id = e.chapter_id) and nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.start_date, equip_qc_hdr.qc_date) <= equip_qc_hdr.qc_date and nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.end_date, equip_qc_hdr.qc_date) >= equip_qc_hdr.qc_date and nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.qc_status, equip_qc_hdr.qc_status) = equip_qc_hdr.qc_status
Block.OrderByClause: order by equip_qc_hdr.equip_reference, equip_qc_hdr.qc_date desc, equip_qc_hdr.qc_type

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 v_local_time date;
begin
 select e.equip_type, e.equip_id, e.status
 into :qc_data.equip_type, :qc_data.equip_id,
 :qc_data.equip_status
 from equipment e
 where e.equip_reference = :qc_data.equip_reference
 and e.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /* Modified by HCL Consulting */
 :qc_data.dummy1 := ' ';
 select substr(mc.code_desc,1,23) into :qc_data.s_status_desc
 from equip_qc_hdr qc, equip_master_codes mc
 where qc.qc_reference = :qc_data.qc_reference
 and mc.code_type = 'QCSTS'
 and mc.code = qc.qc_status;
 
 --
 if :qc_data.qc_date is not null then
 if IS_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,:qc_data.qc_date,v_local_time);
 :qc_data.qc_date := v_local_time;
 end if;
 end if;
 --
 
end;

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_EQUIPMENT_T_LOV0
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select distinct (e.equip_type), substr(mc.code_desc,1,20) from equipment e, equip_master_codes mc where mc.code_type = 'EQUIP' and mc.code = e.equip_type and e.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id and exists (select 'x' from equip_qc_hdr qc where qc.equip_reference = e.equip_reference)

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_EQUIPMENT_I_LOV1
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select e.equip_id, e.equip_reference, substr(decode(least(nvl(e.first_production_date, trunc(sysdate)+1), trunc(sysdate)+1), trunc(sysdate)+1, 'Not yet in service.', 'Service from: '||to_char(e.first_production_date, 'MM-DD-YY')||' to: '||nvl(to_char(e.last_production_date, 'MM-DD-YY'), 'present.')),1,38) from equipment e where e.equip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type and e.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id and exists (select 'x' from equip_qc_hdr qc where qc.equip_reference = e.equip_reference) order by decode(least(nvl(e.first_production_date, trunc(sysdate)+1), trunc(sysdate)+1), trunc(sysdate)+1, '2', decode(least(nvl(e.last_production_date, trunc(sysdate)), trunc(sysdate)), trunc(sysdate), '1', '3')), e.equip_id

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_EQUIPMENT_R_LOV2
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select e.equip_reference, substr(decode(least(nvl(e.first_production_date, trunc(sysdate)+1), trunc(sysdate)+1), trunc(sysdate)+1, 'Not yet in service', 'Service from: ' ||to_char(e.first_production_date, 'MM-DD-YY')||' to: '||nvl(to_char(e.last_production_date, 'MM-DD-YY'), 'Present')),1,38) from equipment e where e.equip_id = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_id and e.equip_type = :ctrl_blk_1.equipment_type and e.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_QC_STATUS_LOV
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select mc.code, substr(mc.code_desc,1,50) from equip_master_codes mc where mc.code_type = 'QCSTS' and sysdate between mc.eff_date and nvl(mc.term_date, sysdate+1)
